mapper.select: SELECT Resv_num AS resvNum, AdminIdx AS adminIdx, UserMail AS userMail, Resv_Price AS resvPrice, Resv_People AS resvPeople, Resv_Status AS resvStatus, Resv_PayStatus AS resvPayStatus, Resv_PayMethod AS resvPayMethod, Resv_ArrivalTime AS resvArrivalTime, Resv_Request AS resvRequest, Resv_Day AS resvDay FROM RESERVATION WHERE Resv_num = #{resvNum}

SELECT UserMail AS userMail, UserPassword AS userPassword, UserNickname AS userNickname, UserAddress AS userAddress, UserCountry AS userCountry, UserTel AS userTel FROM MEMBER WHERE UserMail = #{userMail}

SELECT rm.RoomName AS roomName, p.PlanName AS planName, rr.Resv_CheckIn AS resvCheckIn, rr.Resv_CheckOut AS resvCheckOut, rr.Resv_People AS resvPeople, rr.Resv_Price AS resvPrice FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.RoomIdx = rr.RoomIdx LEFT JOIN PLAN p ON p.PlanIdx = rr.PlanIdx WHERE rr.Resv_num = #{resvNum} ORDER BY rr.RoomResv_num

SELECT c.RestaurantCourseName AS courseName, rr.RestaurantUseDate AS restaurantUseDate, rr.RestaurantTimeSlot AS restaurantTimeSlot, rr.RestaurantHeadcount AS restaurantHeadcount, rr.RestaurantSidemenu AS restaurantSidemenu FROM RESTAURANT_RESERVATION rr LEFT JOIN RESTAURANT_COURSE c ON c.RestaurantCourseIdx = rr.CourseIdx WHERE rr.Resv_num = #{resvNum} ORDER BY rr.RestaurantFacilityIdx

SELECT o.OnsenName AS onsenName, orr.OnsenUseDate AS onsenUseDate, orr.OnsenTimeSlot AS onsenTimeSlot, orr.OnsenHeadcount AS onsenHeadcount, orr.OnsenStatus AS onsenStatus FROM ONSEN_RESERVATION orr LEFT JOIN ONSEN o ON o.OnsenIdx = orr.OnsenIdx WHERE orr.Resv_num = #{resvNum} ORDER BY orr.OnsenFacilityIdx
